#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class FastScanner {
public:
    string next() {
        while (tokens.empty()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(cin, line)) {
                return "";
            }
            stringstream ss(line);
            string token;
            while (ss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
        }
        string res = tokens.front();
        tokens.erase(tokens.begin());
        return res;
    }

    int Int() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long Long() {
        return stol(next());
    }

    string Str() {
        return next();
    }

private:
    vector<string> tokens;
};

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    // Reading number of test cases, but as per original code, T=1
    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        int n = fs.Int();
        int mod = fs.Int();

        vector<vector<long>> dp(n, vector<long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int cnt = 0; cnt <= i; cnt++) {
                    if (j - cnt >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - cnt];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) {
                            dp[i][j] += mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<long>> sums(n, vector<long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long sum = 0;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                sums[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        vector<long> fact(501 * 501, 1);
        for (int i = 2; i < (int)fact.size(); i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        vector<vector<long>> ncr(501, vector<long>(501, 0));
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 501; i++) {
            ncr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + ncr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
                if (ncr[i][j] == 0) ncr[i][j] += mod;
            }
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long com = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            if (com == 0) com += mod;
            long sum = 0;

            vector<long>& last = dp[cnt - 2];
            long ssum = 0;
            long total = 0;
            for (size_t j = 2; j < dp[0].size(); j++) { // j == inversions
                total += sums[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1);
                total %= mod;
                if (total == 0) total += mod;

                sum += last[j] * total;
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;

                ssum += sums[cnt - 2][j - 2];
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) {
                    ssum -= sums[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1];
                }
                ssum += mod;
                ssum %= mod;
                if (ssum == 0) ssum += mod;

                total -= ssum;
                total += mod;
                total %= mod;
                if (total == 0) total += mod;
            }
            res += sum * com;
            res %= mod;
            if (res == 0) res += mod;
        }
        cout << res % mod << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
